text:
lia_cs: Ok team — Nautilus is moving to Dedicated next week. They've signed the contract but asked for a conservative ramp plan. Need final quota numbers, autoscale policy, and a short load-test plan. Renewal check-in in 6w so let's avoid regressions. Who can pick quota?
omar_ops: I can. what's their mix? embeddings vs gen? average token / embed size?
lia_cs: Mix is ~60% embeddings, 40% gen. embeddings are short (64 floats), gen avg 600 tokens but some chat sessions hit 2.5k. Evening batch jobs spike embeddings by ~2000 rps for ~10m.
tess_eng: For cost efficiency we should size by token-rate for gen and rps for embeddings separately. Recommend starting pool = 6 A100 equiv GPUs, with policy to scale +3 GPUs for sustained token-rate > 120k tps over 60s. For embeddings, set separate autoscale target: embed qps > 1500 triggers extra embedding-only workers.
ryan_sre: Agree split-pool approach. Also suggest prefix caching warmup: run a 12h shadow to seed KV caches and embedding caches. If they can't provide traffic, we synth with recorded histograms.
marta_fin: Finance wants a per-month estimate for three scenarios: conservative (current usage), expected (post-onboard), and aggressive (30% growth). Also show delta with prefix KV caching on vs off. I'll need quota draft by EOD tomorrow.
lia_cs: Can we keep scale-down cooldown at 4m? We had oscillations when it was shorter.
notpsbot: typo noted: "opsbot" will confirm.
opsbot: scheduled: shadow-job/nautilus-seed-1845 (ETA 4h).
omar_ops: For the load-test plan I propose: Phase A: cache-seed shadow 12h. Phase B: embedding soak 10m@2k rps. Phase C: gen stepped soak 5m rungs 100/500/1200 concurrent, validate 99p < 700ms.
tess_eng: Canary flow: route 10% of traffic to canary subset (2 GPUs) for first 15m. If error rate > .2% or 99p latency regresses > 20% from baseline, cut back and open fallback to smaller quantized variant.
ryan_sre: Note: last time we saw delayed scale-up because metric shards lagged. Patch 2026.06 resolved most but we'll monitor aggregator lag metric during shadow. If lag > 2s, abort.
lia_cs: action list: @omar_ops quota numbers by EOD tomorrow; @tess_eng prepare canary + fallback PR; @ryan_sre book oncall Thu afternoon for soak; @marta_fin cost scenarios. I'll draft customer comms after quota.
omar_ops: Initial numbers: reserve 6 GPUs (base), burst buffer +3, embedding workers pool 2x for spikes. I'll post a spreadsheet with token-rate calculations and cost per 100M tokens.
marta_fin: thanks — include amortized reserved cost and on-demand delta. Also add audit retention note (customer requested 60d logs).
tess_eng: added a tiny prompt set for regression checks (5 prompts) and an embedding sample for semantic drift checks.
ryan_sre: plan to run wrk for gen soak. Example command we use:
```
wrk -t8 -c800 -d5m --latency http://dedicated/nautilus/v1/generate
```
Adjust -c to match concurrent token pipelines.
lia_cs: one more ask — enable detailed token-level billing in console for this account, customers like the visibility during renewal.
marta_fin: noted. I'll ask billing to flip it on and include dashboard screenshot for renewal pack.
omar_ops: posting quota draft: https://redwood.internal/drive/nautilus-quota-v1 (feedback welcome).
opsbot: deployment window check: Thu 13:00-17:00 shows a planned infra change at 15:30 — we should avoid that slot for the soak.
ryan_sre: good catch. I'll move oncall window to Fri 14:00-18:00 instead.
lia_cs: ok timeline: quota sign-off by tomorrow EOD, shadow seed Fri morning, soak Fri afternoon, tentative go-live Monday morning. Is that feasible?
tess_eng: feasible. We'll have fallback policies ready.
marta_fin: I'll prepare the renewal cost appendix after quota sign-off.
lia_cs: Great. Please post any blockers here. I'll ping Nautilus with draft timeline after quota sign-off. Thanks team :tada:
